stocks:NDAQ.standing: Runs the Nasdaq Stock Market and exchanges in the Nordics and Baltics, and earns more from market data, index licensing and anti-fraud software than from trades. Funds that track the Nasdaq-100 pay it a licence fee.
stocks:NDAQ.recent: The one story about Nasdaq's own business came two days after the chart ends: it joined Broadcom, Verizon and other issuers in objecting to an SEC framework for trading tokenized versions of their shares. Nothing in the input explains the share's move before that.

stocks:VZ.standing: One of the three national US mobile carriers alongside AT&T and T-Mobile, also selling home broadband and fibre. It carries heavy debt from spectrum purchases, and its large dividend makes it an income stock for many holders.
stocks:VZ.recent: Shares fell hardest when SpaceX struck a nationwide low-band spectrum deal for Starlink Mobile, bringing a satellite rival onto the airwaves carriers sell, and AT&T dropped alongside it. Separately, Verizon joined Broadcom and Nasdaq in objecting to the SEC framework that lets crypto venues such as OKX list tokens of its stock without its consent.

poly-trump-putin-and-xi-seen-together-be.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US, Russian and Chinese leaders meet together in person before 2027. A three-way meeting would put Beijing at the table on matters Washington and Moscow usually settle between themselves.
poly-trump-putin-and-xi-seen-together-be.recent: Putin proposed a summit with Trump and Xi to settle a Ukraine deal, a table that would seat three leaders and no Ukrainian. The offer came as Witkoff left the Oslo talks for Moscow, and as the US restored the warnings of Russian air attacks that Kyiv officials suspected Washington had withheld.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats win a majority in the US House of Representatives at the 2026 midterms. The House controls federal spending and can open investigations into the White House.

stocks:SPLS.standing: A PIMCO exchange-traded fund that pairs exposure to US stocks with an actively managed bond portfolio, so its price reflects both the American equity market and the bond returns its managers add on top.

stocks:DTE.DE.standing: Germany's former state phone monopoly, based in Bonn, and Europe's largest telecom operator by revenue. Most of its earnings come from its controlling stake in T-Mobile US, so the dollar and American wireless competition move it.

stocks:ORA.PA.standing: France's largest telecoms operator, formerly the state monopoly France Télécom, selling mobile and broadband across Europe and Africa. The French state remains its largest shareholder.

stocks:TEF.MC.standing: Spain's former state telephone monopoly, which runs Movistar at home, O2 in Germany and Vivo in Brazil. Its heavy debt and Latin American earnings tie the share to interest rates and the Brazilian real.

stocks:VOD.standing: Vodafone, one of Europe's largest mobile operators, based in England with networks across Europe and, through Vodacom, Africa. This is its US-listed share, priced in dollars, so sterling moves reach it too.

stocks:VSAT.standing: A Carlsbad, California satellite operator that bought Inmarsat in 2023. It sells broadband to airlines, ships and the US military from geostationary orbit, and competes with low-orbit fleets such as Starlink.

stocks:ETL.PA.standing: A Paris-listed satellite operator that runs geostationary broadcast satellites and the OneWeb low-orbit broadband constellation, Europe's main commercial alternative to Starlink.

stocks:VOW3.DE.standing: Europe's largest carmaker, based in Wolfsburg and owner of Audi, Porsche, Skoda and SEAT. Its shares price whether a combustion-era giant can sell electric cars in China and keep its German plants full.
stocks:VOW3.DE.recent: The only company news in the input landed after this window closed: Volkswagen plans to give 660,000 workers no raises until 2030, a pay freeze across its global workforce. Nothing in the input accounts for the slide before it.

poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-novembe.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz by November 2. Its price is what traders will stake on a deal that would reopen the Gulf's main oil export route.
poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-novembe.recent: Iran offered terms to reopen Hormuz, but its security chief told Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir, who is carrying mediators' proposals, that no enriched uranium will leave the country, the sticking point in any deal. Meanwhile the Guards said mines set tankers ablaze, and Iran's strait authority blacklisted 122 ships.

poly-ex-cuba-leader-raul-castro-in-us-cu.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Raúl Castro, Fidel's brother, Cuba's president from 2008 to 2018 and party chief until 2021, is in US custody by year's end. Traders bet on Washington getting him before an American court.

poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-texas-se.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Democrat wins the US Senate seat Texas fills in November 2026. Texas last elected a Democrat to the Senate in 1988, so the price shows how far bettors think the party's map has stretched.

stocks:MU.standing: An American maker of memory chips, DRAM and NAND flash, and one of three companies that make most of the world's DRAM. Its share price swings with the memory cycle and with demand for the high-bandwidth memory used in AI servers.
stocks:MU.recent: One of Micron's two unions in Taiwan called a strike for Thursday over bonuses. The dispute surfaced only after the fall had already happened, and nothing else reported in the period accounts for the decline.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the war pausing this year.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.recent: The contract was cheapest when Trump's diesel deal with Russia opened a rift with Europe, as Germany and Ukraine pressed Putin to join a full energy-sector truce. Talks in Oslo, Witkoff's trip to Moscow and Putin's offer of a summit with no Ukrainian at the table followed, and the Kremlin was reported ready to resume talks around 10 November, possibly in Abu Dhabi.

stocks:GOOGL.standing: The parent company of Google, earning most of its revenue from search and YouTube advertising, alongside Google Cloud and Waymo. Its share is a running bet on whether AI assistants strengthen or erode the search ad business.
stocks:GOOGL.recent: Google's own benchmarks put Claude 9 points ahead of its Gemini 4 Argon, staff testing Gemini 4 Carbon likened its coding to Opus 5.5, and Google signed as buyer for 890 megawatts of new nuclear output. None of it accounts for the share price.

poly-saudi-houthi-ceasefire-agreement-an.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthis agree a ceasefire before the year ends. Its price is what traders pay for a yes, and it moves with strikes, mediation and the Red Sea shipping the war hangs over.
poly-saudi-houthi-ceasefire-agreement-an.recent: Traders paid more for a truce even as the war on Saudi soil widened: Houthi strikes shut Riyadh airport and Qatar Airways suspended flights, then missiles killed at least 18 recruits in Shabwa and a drone hit near Shaybah. Nothing in the reporting describes talks between Riyadh and the Houthis that accounts for it.

stocks:CRWV.standing: A US cloud company that rents Nvidia graphics processors to AI developers, financed largely with debt secured against those chips. Its share price shows how much borrowed money the AI build-out can still attract.
stocks:CRWV.recent: Lenders grew nervous about CoreWeave's borrowing, and by the end of the fortnight its troubles were being read as a threat to the whole AI junk market, the high-yield debt that pays for the data-centre build-out. If that market shuts, the company loses the funding its expansion runs on.

poly-will-the-republican-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Republicans hold a majority of the US Senate after the 2026 midterms. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome; the Senate confirms judges, cabinet picks and treaties.

wiki-france.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on France each day. Its peaks mark the days events in the country reached people well beyond its borders.
wiki-france.recent: Pupils' protests over run-down schools drew 161,500 marchers, then turned to riots: nearly 2,400 arrests in one night, the 1883 Limoges town hall burned, an 11pm curfew and a Paris protest ban. France's 10-year bond yield hit its highest since 2002, and Macron rebuked Trump and Netanyahu for blaming migrants and Islam.

wiki-starlink.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Starlink, SpaceX's network of thousands of low-orbit satellites selling broadband to homes, ships, aircraft and armies, Ukraine's front-line drone units among them.
wiki-starlink.recent: Musk blamed Ambani for Starlink's delayed launch in India, and Reliance replied that its own satellite service awaits clearance too. Then Ukraine said SpaceX had throttled its terminals, cutting drone links at 110 km/h mid-mission, while Germany and Lithuania moved against arson attacks on Starlink sites.

stocks:CNDT.standing: A US outsourcing firm spun off from Xerox in 2017 that runs back-office work for governments and companies: benefit payments, toll collection, health claims. Its shares move on state contracts and what they cost to run.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Iran's top leadership changes before the year is out. Its price is what traders will stake on the Islamic Republic's rulers losing power, through war, succession or upheaval.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.recent: Tehran told Asim Munir, who is carrying mediators' proposals, that no enriched uranium will leave Iran, and parliament approved a sanctioned missile builder as defence minister. Both show the sitting leadership acting in office, and nothing in the fortnight's reporting bears on who holds power or explains the price.

stocks:3690.HK.standing: China's largest platform for food delivery and local services, from restaurant orders to hotel bookings, listed in Hong Kong. Its margins swing on subsidy wars with rivals and on Beijing's rules for delivery couriers.

wiki-openai.standing: The San Francisco company behind ChatGPT and the GPT models, founded in 2015 as a nonprofit research lab and now one of the largest commercial AI developers. Its releases and prices set the terms its rivals compete on.
wiki-openai.recent: The FBI arrested an OpenAI engineer after a thumb-sized recorder turned up behind a television in an executive conference room, and the engineer was later tied to Riyadh. A day later a US regulator sent OpenAI and Anthropic more than 50 pages of questions; this week OpenAI priced writes to its 12-hour prompt cache at 2.5 times input.

stocks:XYZ.standing: The company behind Square's card readers and software for small merchants and Cash App, a US peer-to-peer payments app. Its share moves with small-business and consumer spending, and it holds bitcoin on its balance sheet.

poly-will-aleksandar-vucic-united-serbia.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Aleksandar Vučić's Serbian Progressive Party wins the most seats in Serbia's 2026 parliamentary election. The party has led every government in Belgrade since 2012.

poly-will-flavio-bolsonaro-win-the-most-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Flávio Bolsonaro wins the most votes in Amapá, a small state in Brazil's far north, in the runoff. It prices one state's tally, not the national result.
poly-will-flavio-bolsonaro-win-the-most-.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's reporting is about Amapá. What it carried from Brazil's runoff was about Meta: researchers logged over 1,000 restrictions on political content, and Meta admitted its AI generated images favouring Flávio Bolsonaro. Neither accounts for the betting.

stocks:AIR.PA.standing: The European airliner maker that splits the world's large-jet market with Boeing, listed in Paris. Its jet deliveries drive the share; a defence and space arm builds military aircraft, satellites and rocket parts.
stocks:AIR.PA.recent: The fortnight brought Airbus shipping the first lighter engine bay for Ariane 6 Block 2, which saves less weight than first planned, and the first flight of its U740 Valkyrie drone at Mach 0.8. Neither accounts for the share price.

stocks:8473.T.standing: A Tokyo financial group that runs SBI Securities, Japan's largest online brokerage, alongside banking, asset management and crypto businesses. Its share follows Japanese retail trading volumes and the group's digital-asset bets.

stocks:055550.KS.standing: One of South Korea's largest financial groups, owner of Shinhan Bank, Shinhan Card and insurance and brokerage arms. Its share tracks Korean interest rates, household credit and the won.
stocks:055550.KS.recent: The one story in the input about Shinhan's own business was a plan, still at the looking stage, to let Japanese visitors pay in Korea with yen stablecoins. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-will-a-us-iran-deal-in-2026-include.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether a US-Iran agreement reached in 2026 has Iran hand over its stockpile of enriched uranium, the material at the centre of the nuclear dispute and of any settlement between the two.
poly-will-a-us-iran-deal-in-2026-include.recent: Lavrov came to Tehran offering to mediate the US-Israeli war on Iran, and Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 6 days. But Iran's security chief told Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir, carrying the mediators' proposals, that no enriched uranium will leave the country, which is the exact point this contract pays on.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-ohio-g.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if the Republican nominee wins Ohio's 2026 governor's race. Republicans have won every Ohio governor's race since 2010, and the price is what traders pay to bet that run continues.

poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-nevada-g.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if a Democrat wins Nevada's 2026 governor's race. Nevada swings between the parties, and its governor holds the veto over a legislature Democrats have long controlled.

poly-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-by-octob.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine hold peace talks by the end of October 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on envoys' trips, summit proposals and Kremlin statements.
poly-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-by-octob.recent: After Witkoff's Moscow visit, the Kremlin said Russia would return to US-mediated talks with Ukraine around 10 November, possibly in Abu Dhabi. That is after this contract closes, according to TASS and TRT World. Putin's proposed summit with Trump and Xi would seat no Ukrainian.

wiki-china.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on China each day. The count rises when a trade dispute, a summit or a military move puts the world's second-largest economy in front of readers who want the basics.
wiki-china.recent: None of the past fortnight's China news lines up with the early-October peak: the EU planned to cut imports of Chinese hybrid cars by half, retail sales rose 1.1% against a 0.5% forecast, the central bank began lending to funds as well as banks, and MiniMax undercut DeepSeek's pricing.

poly-will-indiana-enact-a-data-center-mo.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Indiana enacts a pause on new data center construction before 2027. It is a bet on a state fight over the power and water that hyperscale campuses draw from local grids.

poly-will-chiang-wan-an-win-the-next-tai.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Chiang Wan-an, Taipei's Kuomintang mayor, wins the city's next mayoral election. Taipei's mayoralty has long been a springboard to Taiwan's presidency.
poly-will-chiang-wan-an-win-the-next-tai.recent: The fortnight's election news came from Brazil's runoff, the voter-roll protests in New Delhi and a seat Labour held in London; none of it concerns Taipei or accounts for the fall in what traders will pay on Chiang Wan-an.

poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States invades Iran before 2027. Its price is what traders will stake on the step past strikes and blockade: American forces entering Iranian territory.
poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.recent: Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 6 days and Lavrov came to Tehran to mediate. But Tehran told Munir that no enriched uranium will leave, the sticking point in any deal, and Netanyahu met Hegseth in secret at a south Israel airbase. Then the Revolutionary Guard said 7 tankers were hit overnight.

wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.standing: Iran's ideological military force, founded after the 1979 revolution to guard it and kept separate from the regular army. It commands the missile arsenal, the Gulf naval force, operations abroad and a large share of the economy.
wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.recent: The Guards ran a campaign of mines and strikes in the Strait of Hormuz. Six ships were hit in one day, a container ship carrying 2,500 containers sank, and on 2026-10-22 the Guards said 7 tankers were hit overnight. Separately, Britain blamed the IRGC for the plot at RAF Fairford, an airbase used by the US.

stocks:300750.SZ.standing: Contemporary Amperex Technology, the Ningde company listed in Shenzhen and the world's largest maker of electric-vehicle batteries. Carmakers from Tesla to BYD's rivals buy its cells, so its share tracks the EV and grid-storage build-out.

stocks:BARC.L.standing: Britain's second-largest bank by assets, combining a UK high-street bank and the Barclaycard business with one of the few European investment banks still competing on Wall Street. Its share price follows both UK rates and trading revenue.
stocks:BARC.L.recent: Barclays reported a quarter that missed estimates and paired it with a trade: 5,000 jobs cut, about 5% of staff, in a 'technology-enabled' cost drive built on AI, while shareholders get a buyback. It is one of the first big banks to name AI as the reason for cuts at this scale, and they fall on back-office and operations staff, many in India and the UK.

poly-will-deepseek-ipo-by-december-31-20.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if DeepSeek, the Hangzhou AI lab spun out of the hedge fund High-Flyer, lists its shares before 2028. A listing would open China's most closely watched AI lab to public shareholders.

poly-will-marine-le-pen-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marine Le Pen wins France's 2027 presidential election. She took the far-right National Rally into the runoff in 2017 and 2022, and lost both to Emmanuel Macron.

poly-clarity-act-signed-into-law-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the US Digital Asset Market Clarity Act becomes law in 2026. The bill would split oversight of crypto tokens between the SEC and the CFTC, settling which regulator the industry answers to.
poly-clarity-act-signed-into-law-in-2026.recent: The fortnight's news from Washington was about prediction markets themselves, not the bill: 39 states and 145 tribal nations urged the Supreme Court to take up their status, and Kalshi's CEO said state-led oversight would push them out. None of it touched the Clarity Act's path to a signature.

poly-will-yashar-win-the-most-seats-in-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Yashar wins more Knesset seats than any other party in Israel's 2026 election. Coming first does not guarantee power: governing takes a 61-seat coalition in the 120-seat Knesset.
poly-will-yashar-win-the-most-seats-in-t.recent: The run-up to the vote brought Netanyahu a defamation suit from former Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar, and an unannounced visit from US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth days before the election. None of it concerned Yashar, and none of it accounts for the bet on it.

wiki-anthropic.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Anthropic, the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models. It is one of a few labs building frontier systems, and its funding, revenue and safety policies shape how the industry is regulated.
wiki-anthropic.recent: An investor put Anthropic's third-quarter revenue at $16.8 billion, and investors discussed a $1.5 trillion valuation, the same week a US regulator sent it and OpenAI more than 50 pages of questions. Days later it gave six outside auditors a seat in its office, pledged 5% of its shares to a public fund, and Nscale sought a second $45 billion contract.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-democr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, becomes his party's 2028 presidential nominee. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-iliana-iotova-win-the-2026-bul.standing: A Polymarket contract on Bulgaria's 2026 presidential election that pays out if Iliana Iotova wins the first round by a margin of 10 to 20 points. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats control the US Senate after the 2026 midterm elections. The Senate confirms judges and cabinet officers, so whoever holds it decides who a president can appoint.
poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.recent: The fortnight's US news concerned the market itself rather than the race: 39 states and 145 tribal nations urged Supreme Court review of prediction markets. Nothing in it accounts for the price.

stocks:LNG.standing: The largest exporter of liquefied natural gas in the United States, from terminals at Sabine Pass in Louisiana and Corpus Christi in Texas. It sells most of its output on long-term contracts to buyers in Europe and Asia.

stocks:VTRS.standing: A generic drugmaker formed in 2020 when Mylan merged with Pfizer's Upjohn unit. It sells off-patent brands such as Lipitor and Viagra, and supplies low-cost HIV medicines to public health systems worldwide.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republic.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if JD Vance, Trump's vice president, wins the 2028 Republican presidential nomination. Its price is what traders pay on the party's first race without Trump on the ballot since 2012.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republic.recent: The fortnight's prediction-market news was about regulation, not the race: 39 states and 145 tribal nations urged the Supreme Court to take up the industry, and Kalshi's CEO said state-led oversight would push markets out. None of it concerns Vance or accounts for the price.

stocks:7782.T.standing: The shares of Sincere Co., a Japanese company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and priced in yen. The quote tracks what investors pay for one share of the company's own business.

poly-will-aleksandar-vucic-be-the-next-p.standing: A contract on whether Aleksandar Vučić, Serbia's president since 2017 and barred from a third term, returns to the prime minister's office he held before. It is a bet on where power in Belgrade sits once his presidency ends.

stocks:CMCSA.standing: America's largest cable operator, selling Xfinity broadband, TV and mobile, and the owner of NBCUniversal's studios, Peacock and theme parks. Its broadband subscriber count is the figure its shareholders watch most closely.
stocks:CMCSA.recent: Comcast lost 144,000 residential broadband customers in Q3, up from 91,000 a year earlier, as fiber and fixed-wireless rivals undercut its prices. It called those prices 'irrational' and answered with cable job cuts and more AI agents, cutting its own costs rather than matching them on price.

poly-bank-of-mexico-decreases-interest-r.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Banco de México cuts its overnight rate by a quarter point after November. That rate sets borrowing costs across Mexico and the yield gap that draws foreign money into the peso.
poly-bank-of-mexico-decreases-interest-r.recent: The fortnight's rate news came from the Fed, not Banxico: Warsh withheld guidance and called AI a shock to the economy, and nearly all economists said the Fed would skip October but raise rates again in December. None of it was about Mexico's central bank, and none of it accounts for the bets on a Banxico cut.
